Card Q&A.a: No, [Security] effects only activate when flipped over from the security stack.
Card Q&A.q: I use this card's inherited effect to trash an opponent's Security Card. Does the security effect on that card activate?

Card Q&A.a: No, this effect only trashes the top card of your opponent's security stack. It doesn't win you the game if it's empty.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has an empty security stack. If I have a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards, and I use it to attack and delete an opponent's Digimon and survive, do I win the game?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle and survives, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
